title: Separated and universally closed quasi-compact quasi-separated morphisms characterized by the valuative criterion
author: The Stacks Project Authors

difficulty_reason: Counts the author Lemma: for a quasi-compact and quasi-separated morphism f : X -> Y of algebraic spaces over S, the following are equivalent: f is separated and universally closed, the valuative criterion holds in the sense of the chapter, and every solid diagram with a valuation ring has a unique dotted arrow in the sense of schemes (source lines 9247-9268). The proof first records the two implications linking separatedness with the uniqueness part of the criterion (in both directions), which shows that in each of the three cases f is separated and satisfies uniqueness; the equivalence is then a formal consequence of the characterisation of universally closed quasi-separated morphisms by the existence part of the criterion.
